task.title: Preparing to record
task.shortdesc: Checks to make in any order before you press Record: input level, sample rate and disk space.

context.p: None of these checks depends on another, so do them in whatever order suits you.

step.cmd: Speak at normal volume and watch the recording meter; aim for peaks around -12 .

tutorialinfo.p: Leaving headroom avoids clipping, the flat-topped distortion that no effect can repair.

step.cmd: Set the project sample rate to 44,100 Hz in the bottom-left corner of the window.
Check that the drive holding the project has at least 1 GB free.

info.p: An hour of stereo audio at 44,100 Hz and 32-bit float needs about 1.2 GB.
